summary: Make external publish receipts durable and idempotent

delivery.outcome: Record repository-bound publish outcomes in a durable receipt log and suppress duplicate successful retries by deterministic idempotency key.
nonGoals: No remote issue deletion or credential changes
No changes to the legacy sync operations implementation
No automatic merge or required-check policy changes

architecture.decision: Keep receipts in a lock-protected Planfile sync sidecar; derive the idempotency key from repository, ticket and sanitized payload digest, and never persist tokens or raw exception text.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; retain the receipt sidecar for forensic recovery and do not delete remote issues.

commands: uv run ruff check planfile/sync/outbound.py planfile/sync/receipts.py tests/test_sync_receipts.py
